reason: C17 SelectField: an option click inside a wrapping label was forwarded by the browser to the trigger and reopened the menu, and a click on the label caption while the menu was open closed it and reopened it. The menu now cancels the default action of clicks inside it, and the outside-pointer rule treats the wrapping label's caption as part of the control. Parameters, states, visual design and keyboard behaviour are unchanged; the creation-workbench FieldLabel workaround is removed.
